name: Prone L-Raise
steps: Lie face down on a mat with your upper arms abducted straight out to your sides at 90 degrees.
Bend your elbows to 90 degrees so your forearms rest on the floor pointing directly forward, forming an 'L' shape.
Keeping your elbows on or slightly hovering off the floor, rotate your forearms and hands upward toward the ceiling.
Pause for one count at peak external rotation.
Slowly rotate your forearms back down until your hands gently touch the floor.
coaching_cues: Pivot strictly around the elbow axis without sliding your elbows forward or back.
Only lift as high as comfortable without any pinching in the front of your shoulder.
